response.overview: In ancient times, the legendary Yu the Great imprisoned an evil dragon in Hidden Dragon Ravine. To escape, the dragon transformed its powers into three magical pearls capable of breaking the seal. Thousands of years later, a lotus spirit, hoping to reunite with her beloved Cangqiong, agrees to help the dragon recover the pearls. Meanwhile, Lichuan and Longyuan find themselves transported into a fantastical world, where their souls mysteriously switch bodies. Drawn into the dragon's scheme, they face supernatural dangers and devastating choices, culminating in Lichuan's ultimate sacrifice to save Longyuan, leaving their souls permanently exchanged.
response.title: The Dragon Legend
